name: Stick Fighter vs Zombies 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Stick Fighter vs Zombies is an action-packed 2D platformer where you control a red stickman battling endless waves of zombies in a blocky world reminiscent of Minecraft. Get ready for epic fights as you face off against zombies, skeleton archers, withers, and even Noob in this thrilling survival game!
